title: "Meaningless"
subtitle: Hush, tread carefully with every choice—but at the same time, savor each one of them.

items.text: "Meaningless"
Processing Area, Prison
Monday is the "busy period" at this prison intake center, as more offenders are offloaded and delivered into the prison system's clutches.
A tequila ad jingle blares from an old radio above, while an arm sporting a pork chop tattoo waves for Mercuria to stop.

items.speaker: Prison Officer
items.text: Left hand.

items.speaker: Prison Officer
items.text: Right hand.

items.speaker: Prison Officer
items.text: Turn around.

items.speaker: Prison Officer
items.text: You're not allowed to have any items hidden on your person.

items.speaker: Prison Officer
items.text: Go on, Miss. You're good to head on in.
Dodging a pineapple can tossed from who knows where, she steps onto the noisy floor and enters the visitation room.
Her friend has been waiting a long time.
Visiting Room

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: See what I mean? If these pencil-pushers can stick a guy in a pink prison suit just for kicks, there's nothing they wouldn't do.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: You know that old country song? "Some things never change."

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: How are the Cheshire Cats holding up?

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: It's grim—the boss is dead, and the rest of us? All locked away, with no light at the end of the tunnel. Well, except me, of course.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: Around here, death row's a revolving door. One second, you've got a neighbor; the next, they're gone.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: You're looking better than I expected.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: Ha! I ain't like those mugs over there, brawling over a hand of cards. Me? I'm built different.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: I've got dreams, you know.
Dreams were life's great equalizer—polished visions for the rich, and a rallying cry for the poor.
Behind bars, a dream keeps hope alive another day, even if it is pure folly.
She nods in response, but her eyes never stray far from Fingers's mangled hand.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: Longing. Intense longing, swelling with every iron-tinged night.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: Your desire ... might be what you'd call a dream, wouldn't it?

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: I see now. That's why your energy's in such turmoil. Your hands are raw with the anxiety this "dream" has brought you.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: Right.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: Pfft—ha! Hahaha!

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: Figures! You've always seen right through people, like we're just fish trapped in a glass bowl to you.
Mercuria remains unfazed, the silence broken only by a soft sigh.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: Shame.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: You need my healing, but my arcane implements were confiscated. They even took the selenium and lapis lazuli.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: Oh, oh—yeah, yeah, yeah, I need you, my little rambling genius.
The conversation circles back as Fingers regains his focus.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: Like the good ol' days—you really helped out our crew back then, and the boss.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: But this isn't about cleansing energy or anything. I need you to do something important.
Once again, he grinds his nails, their pointed tips dragging over the metal surface of the table.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: The boss is gone, and his most precious possession's got no one to look after it now.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: What I need is for you to track it down.
Fingers pulls out an old photograph.
MacGuffin the Knife
A name.
A name is a code, a symbol, a query or a resolution, a term of endearment, a lingering sigh, or the very start and end of someone's journey.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: You're looking at the sole copy of this photo—one of a kind.
An unhurried inspection ensues, burning every detail of the picture into her mind's eye.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: Is that so?

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: That's right. No matter what happens, get it and bring it to me.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: The day after tomorrow.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: Two days from now, I'm a free man. Seven sharp in the evening, make sure I get it.
She gives no reply. Her gaze is still locked on the photograph, as if seeing something beyond it.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: I always help my friends, provided it doesn't breach my principles. A favor along the way, nothing more.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: But I do have a request.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: I'm all ears.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: May I bring someone along?
Cheese St.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: Northeast ... one step, two, three ...

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Sniff, sniff, woof, sniff, sniff ... woof!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Hrrr—woof, woof!
Along the busy roadway, a thick-furred Border Collie yanks a silver-haired disco girl along, their eyes locked on a red balloon in the air.
She initially means to head in a different direction, but the sudden pull of the leash trips her up before she can adjust.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: Ah! Oh!
After a noisy struggle, the dog slams into a trash can, and Mercuria finds herself thoroughly tangled in the leash.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof, snarl ...

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Grrr ...

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof ... woof, woof, woof ... woof, woof.
Mercuria lowers her head, unwinding the leash looped around her legs.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: You're worried, Pickles.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Hmm? Woof, woof?
Mercuria nods.
A conflicted look settles on the dog's face.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof, woof ... Woof, woof, woof.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof, woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof, woof ... woof!
Pickles emits a low, tender whine.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof ... woof, woof, woof ...

items.speaker: "Doggie"
items.text: The puppy cannot believe his eyes.
Pickles reaches out, his paw resting lightly on the photo in Mercuria's grasp.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Snarl ... Grrr, grrr ...
The dog points with his paw at the central figure in the photograph.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof, woof.
The focus of the photograph is a small dog with bright eyes.
It beams back at the photographer, as if on the verge of charging forward with unyielding courage, prepared to bring down the photographer or even the whole world.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: Yes, it's in its belly—a genuine hoard of Rheingold.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: And whoever claims the Rheingold within shall find great fortune.
